importWizard.historyNoCompany: Select a company to see its import history.
importWizard.historyOffline: You are offline. Import history will load when you reconnect.
importWizard.historyOfflineCached: You are offline. Showing the last loaded import history.
importWizard.historyError: Could not load the import history.
importWizard.historyStale: Could not refresh the import history. Showing the last loaded list.
importWizard.historyEmpty: No imports yet. Your previewed and committed files will appear here.
importWizard.title: Import data
importWizard.description: Bring your books over from Xero, QuickBooks Online, Zoho Books or Wafeq. Each file is previewed and validated before anything is written.
importWizard.modeBalance: Post A/R and A/P balances from the trial balance
importWizard.modeDocuments: Carry A/R and A/P by importing open invoices and bills
importWizard.chooseFile: Choose a CSV file to enable Preview.
importWizard.order: Recommended order: chart of accounts, then opening balances, then contacts and items, then open invoices and bills.
importWizard.fxHint: Foreign-currency documents are supported: amounts stay in the document currency (Currency column) and are converted at the document-date rate, from an Exchange Rate column or your Exchange Rates. Settlement books the realised FX difference.
importWizard.readyToValidate: Next: validate the file against your books.
importWizard.readyToCommit: Validation passed. Review the rows above, then commit the import.
importWizard.noRows: No data rows were found in this file. Check that it is the right export, that it has a header row and at least one data row, then choose it again.
importWizard.fixCsv: Fix the errors in your CSV file, then choose it again and run Preview. The import cannot be committed while errors remain.
importWizard.fixNoUsableRows: The file has data, but none of its rows can be imported. Check the amounts and required values, then choose it again and run Preview.
importWizard.fixCutOver: Choose the cut-over date above, then run Preview again.
importWizard.fixCutOverFuture: Choose a cut-over date that is not in the future, then run Preview again.
importWizard.fixCutOverMismatch: Set the cut-over date above to the trial balance date, then run Preview again.
importWizard.fixDocumentsMode: Under Receivables and payables, choose to carry A/R and A/P by importing open invoices and bills, then run Preview again. This applies to the trial balance import.
importWizard.fixAlreadyImported: These balances are already in your books. Do not import them again.
importWizard.fixChart: Update the chart of accounts (add or reactivate the accounts listed), then validate again.
importWizard.fixExchangeRate: Add the missing rate under Exchange rates and validate again, or add a rate column to the file and run Preview again.
importWizard.fixGratuity: Record each employee's opening gratuity provision in Payroll, then validate again.
importWizard.fixAssets: Import the fixed-asset register with its opening balances, then validate again.
importWizard.fixStock: Record opening stock for your products in Inventory, then validate again.
importWizard.fixOther: Resolve the errors listed above, then run Preview or Validate again.
importWizard.issueUnknown: This item could not be accepted (issue code {code}).
importWizard.issue.COLUMN_MISSING: No column found for {field}. Headers seen: {headers}
importWizard.issue.NO_ROWS: No rows in the file can be imported
importWizard.issue.INVALID_AMOUNT: Invalid amount: check debit and credit, sales price or cost (at most 2 decimals)
importWizard.issue.INVALID_TRN: TRN is not 15 digits and will be left blank
importWizard.issue.INVALID_DUE_DATE: Due date not recognised; left blank
importWizard.issue.CONTACT_REQUIRED: Customer or vendor name is required
importWizard.issue.INVALID_TOTAL: Total must be a positive amount
importWizard.issue.INVALID_CURRENCY: Currency is not an ISO 4217 code
importWizard.issue.V_CUT_OVER_IN_FUTURE: The cut-over date cannot be in the future
importWizard.issue.V_DUPLICATE_CODE: Code {code} appears twice in the file
importWizard.issue.V_CODE_EXISTS: Account {code} already exists and will be kept as is
importWizard.issue.V_UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT: Account {code} is not in the chart of accounts; import the chart first
importWizard.issue.V_PL_ACCOUNT: Account {code} is a P&L account: its year-to-date balance is posted on the cut-over date
importWizard.issue.V_UNBALANCED: Total debits do not equal total credits
importWizard.issue.V_OPENING_ALREADY_IMP: An opening trial balance has already been imported for this company
importWizard.issue.V_DOCUMENTS_ALREADY_I: Open invoices or bills were already imported and carry A/R and A/P
importWizard.issue.V_AR_CONTROL_MISMATCH: A/R in the trial balance differs from the open invoices imported
importWizard.issue.V_AP_CONTROL_MISMATCH: A/P in the trial balance differs from the open bills imported
importWizard.issue.V_OBE_CREATED: Account 3040 Opening Balance Equity will be created
importWizard.issue.V_AR_WITHOUT_DOCUMENT: The trial balance carries accounts receivable with no customer invoices behind it
importWizard.issue.V_AP_WITHOUT_DOCUMENT: The trial balance carries accounts payable with no supplier bills behind it
importWizard.issue.V_GRATUITY_WITHOUT_EM: The gratuity provision in the trial balance must equal the opening provisions on your employees
importWizard.issue.V_GRATUITY_NOT_IN_TB: Employees carry opening gratuity provisions that are not in this trial balance; 3040 keeps that amount
importWizard.issue.V_PPE_REGISTER_MISMAT: Property, plant and equipment must equal the fixed-asset register
importWizard.issue.V_PPE_WITHOUT_REGISTE: Property, plant and equipment has no matching fixed-asset register
importWizard.issue.V_PPE_NOT_IN_TB: The fixed-asset register has opening balances that are not in this trial balance; 3040 keeps them
importWizard.issue.V_VAT_OPENING_IN_RETU: The VAT balance belongs to the tax period containing the cut-over date; that period's return reports it, so do not add a separate adjustment
importWizard.issue.V_VAT_IN_OPENING: Control accounts {code} cannot take an opening balance: carry this VAT on a non-VAT account such as 2040
importWizard.issue.V_GRNI_IN_OPENING: Control accounts {code} cannot take an opening balance: carry the accrual on 2040
importWizard.issue.V_PAYROLL_PAYABLE_IN_: Control accounts {code} cannot take an opening balance: carry unpaid payroll amounts on 2040
importWizard.issue.V_INVENTORY_WITHOUT_S: Inventory in the trial balance must equal the opening stock on your products
importWizard.issue.V_EXISTS: The record already exists and will be skipped
importWizard.issue.V_DUPLICATE: The record appears twice and is imported once
importWizard.issue.V_NO_OPENING_STOCK: Imported without stock: record opening stock with an inventory adjustment
importWizard.issue.V_CONTROL_ACCOUNT_MIS: The A/R or A/P control account is missing from the chart
importWizard.issue.V_AFTER_CUT_OVER: The document is dated after the cut-over date; enter it as a normal document
importWizard.issue.V_CONTROL_IN_OPENING_: The opening trial balance already posted this A/R or A/P balance; importing open documents would count it twice
importWizard.issue.V_CONTROL_TOTAL_MISMA: Open documents must equal the matching A/R or A/P balance of the opening trial balance
importWizard.issue.V_CUT_OVER_MISMATCH: Use the trial balance cut-over date {date}
importWizard.issue.V_NO_OPENING_TB: Until the opening trial balance is imported, the offset sits in Opening Balance Equity
importWizard.issue.V_STALE_EXCHANGE_RATE: The exchange rate on file is out of date for this document
importWizard.issue.V_NO_EXCHANGE_RATE: No exchange rate for the document date
